items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: I made a number about Piney Brown 'cause I used to work for him all the time

ctx.x: I made a number about Piney Brown 'cause I used to work for him all the time, and we worked on...we worked on Twelfth Street-- Twelfth and Highland--to a nightclub called the Sunset Club. Across the street they had a club called the Lone Star. Some I-talians run that. Colored people run the joint where I worked at. So I, uh...we used to do shows in the mornin'--five o'clock in the mornin'.
